answer: Sponsor-decay bond: a wharf sponsor stakes a 70-credit bond behind each newcomer filing one reef log per tide. A missed or false reef log decays the sponsor's stake 10% and burns the newcomer's bond; the wharf ledger lists every decayed stake each tide. A rented sponsor backing many fakes sees every stake decay at once. The k-th fake pays 45+6(k-1): 1,000 fakes pay 3,042,000 and lock 70,000 against a 40,000 pool. Honest newcomers pay 45 once.
